verdict.rationale: Algolia ships official InstantSearch UI libraries (React, JS, Vue, Angular, iOS, Android) with prebuilt widgets for search box, results, facets/refinement lists, and pagination, plus the ability to customize or build custom widgets, all documented with quickstarts. Community feedback independently corroborates strong developer experience with the React InstantSearch plugin. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of facet/pagination assembly specifically, and no first-party benchmark of accessibility/completeness across all supported frameworks.
